title: netpulse AG Reveals New Findings on Search Intent in German Language Queries Within AI-Generated Answers
author: Netpulse Ag
description: netpulse AG, a Swiss digital marketing agency, released research on how brands appear in AI-generated search answers across ChatGPT, Perplexity, and Google AI Mode. The study found that generative engines prioritize sources with clear topical structure and strong technical foundations over advertising spend, and that companies visible in organic search are more likely to appear in AI answers. The agency uses proprietary tools to measure AI visibility rather than third-party metrics.

title: Nvidia Hits a New All-Time High. Is the AI Stock a Buy?
author: Jeremy Bowman
description: Nvidia reached a new all-time high of $243.37 per share, driven by positive macro conditions and strong AI sector momentum. Trading at a P/E ratio of 30, the stock appears undervalued compared to peers like AMD (166 P/E) and Intel (103 P/E), with Wall Street expecting 67% revenue growth to $687 billion in fiscal 2028. While the law of large numbers may eventually constrain growth and competition from AMD, Intel, and custom chips from Amazon and Google pose risks, analysts view Nvidia as well-positioned to capitalize on AI growth and recommend it as a strong buy.

title: Why Constellation Energy Rallied Today
author: Billy Duberstein
description: Constellation Energy stock surged 12.31% after signing a comprehensive power deal with Alphabet. The agreement includes a 20-year, 890-MW power purchase agreement and a 15-year, 2,700-MW PPA to supply nuclear power to Alphabet's AI data centers in the PJM grid region. Constellation will invest $4.3 billion to expand nuclear capacity, while Alphabet will use Google Cloud's Gemini Enterprise to help optimize power production efficiency.

title: 3 Growth Stocks to Buy Instead of SpaceX
author: Marc Guberti
description: The article argues that SpaceX's $2 trillion valuation is too high relative to its revenue, even accounting for projected $100 billion annual recurring revenue by 2026, resulting in a price-to-sales ratio above 20. Instead, the author recommends three better-valued growth stocks: SanDisk (strong NAND memory demand from AI), MaxLinear (optical data center products), and nVent (liquid cooling solutions for data centers).

title: Not Microsoft. Not Google. Analysts Call This $2.7 Trillion Tech Titan the Most Undervalued AI Play.
author: Brett Schafer
description: Amazon is positioned as an undervalued AI play despite its $2.7 trillion market cap. AWS revenue grew 37% year-over-year to $42.2 billion, driven by AI infrastructure demand. The company is also integrating AI across its retail business through search tools, ad targeting, and supply chain automation. With projected earnings of $161 billion and a forward P/E of 17, analysts believe Amazon stock has significant upside potential.
